`analyzeLandscape` is now a second name for `updateLandscape`, and the README has a short section on it. The cli module's tests pass offline. I did not run the jar, so the `-help` output and the no-argument overview are checked only by reading the code.

Changes:

- **`cli/.../Commands.java`**: added `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE` and its description, which says it is the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands and the same as `updateLandscape`. The no-argument overview now lists it, using the same landscape options.
- **`cli/.../CommandLineInterface.java`**: `analyzeLandscape` dispatches to the same `updateLandscape(args)` method, so both names share one code path and options. For `-help`, the usage line and description now follow the name the user typed.
- **`README.md`**: the README had no command reference, so I added a "Landscape report" section. It shows the `analyzeLandscape -analysisRoot <folder>` example and describes both names. Tell me if you wanted something else there.

Nothing is committed. I did not run `java -cp … CommandLineInterface analyzeLandscape -help` because that command needed approval I could not get here. A quick check is `java -jar cli/target/sokrates.jar analyzeLandscape -help` after `mvn -o -pl cli package`.
